D.t: Kathy Hochul leads by 16.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 1,146,452 votes; a one point swing is about 34,804 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +9.8 and D +23.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +10.8. Your best recent poll is Beacon Research (D)/Shaw & Co. Research (R) at D +20.3; your worst is Pollfinity Research at D +4.0. 10 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: New York, a projected net 417,265 votes; Kings, a projected net 389,199 votes; Queens, a projected net 200,423 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Suffolk, R +9.5, 9.0% of the vote; Nassau, R +3.1, 8.4% of the vote; Orange, R +6.8, 2.1% of the vote; Dutchess, D +5.7, 1.8% of the vote.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Kathy Hochul runs furthest behind in Oneida, Niagara, Suffolk. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 71% of voters, 51 to 48, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.56 points; Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 61% of voters, 57 to 41, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.07 points; Voters who find daily costs hard to afford, 60% of voters, 59 to 39, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.00 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Kathy Hochul: Immigration voters 27 to 72, Small counties 34 to 64, Midsize counties 46 to 53. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.
$18.5M cash against $178K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
Money: Raised $6.3M against $2.6M for Kathy Hochul.
